title: fix(lint): field-no-consumers lists a field permission grant's OBJECT.FIELD key as a carrier site
body:
Fixes #32628
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`field-no-consumers` 现在把权限集 `fields` 里 `OBJECT.FIELD` 形式的字段级授权键记为该字段的一个 carrier 站点;`os explain field-no-consumers` 同步写明字段权限的 `when` 是读、授权键是 carrier。
- **为什么改**:规范唯一接受的字段授权写法(`fields: { 'showcase_project.budget': {...} }`)此前被记为"无站点",字段被判 `inert`,`fix:` 行说没有别处要清理;照做删掉字段后,授权键会留着去遮一个已不存在的列。
- **风险与回滚**:只是一条 warning 的判定与提示文案变化,不拒收任何元数据;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts`(新增 `fieldPermissionGrantOf` 与 walk 中记录 carrier 的那一段)、`packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts`(新 describe 块与迁到规范形状的旧 pin)、`.changeset/32628-field-grant-carrier-site.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts`,预期 193 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts`: a new `fieldPermissionGrantOf` reads a permission set's `fields` key the way `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` does: the head before the first `.` is the object (through the existing `fieldPermissionObjectOf`, whose map key `FIELD_PERMISSIONS_KEY` is typed `satisfies keyof PermissionSet`), and the whole remainder is the field. When the object declares that field, the walk records a **carrier** site at `permissions[i].fields["OBJECT.FIELD"]` (the quoted spelling `validate-security-posture` uses for the same entry, because the key holds a `.`). A grant reads nothing, so it never counts as a consumer; a key whose remainder names no declared field (an unqualified key, a dotted remainder, an unknown field or object) records no site. The docblocks that said the key is "never read as a reference" now say it is a carrier.
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (`field-no-consumers` only): paragraph 1 names a field permission's row condition (`fields[...].when`) among the reads, as the ACCEPT of the previous PR on this rule asked; paragraph 2 names the grant key among the carriers.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts`: every pin that used the off-spec `permissions[].objects.X.fields.Y` shape now uses the spec shape, with `PermissionSetSchema.safeParse` on the fixture (the corpus, the "a carrier never rescues" case, and the RLS block's grant case). A new `describe` pins: a field named only by a spec-shaped grant reads `carrier-only` with the grant path in `fix:`; a name-keyed set map carries the same way; a grant whose `when` reads another field carries its own target and credits the other; a grant never carries another object's same-name field; four keys that name no declared field record no site.
- `.changeset/32628-field-grant-carrier-site.md`: patch on `@objectstack/lint`.

## Tests

Probe on the real producer (`examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts`, `ContributorPermissionSet`, keys `showcase_project.budget` / `.spent` / `.budget_remaining`), with a minimal `showcase_project` object and an empty view, the base copy of the rule against the head copy:

```text
BEFORE e4d75d6de showcase_project.budget inert [] | fix: add it to a view column or a form section, or remove the declaration
AFTER HEAD showcase_project.budget carrier-only ["permissions[0].fields[\"showcase_project.budget\"]"] | fix: ... remove the declaration together with its 1 carrier site(s): permissions[0].fields["showcase_project.budget"]
```

The premise holds: at `e4d75d6de` the spec-shaped grant was recorded as no site.

Ablation (committed fix first, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `if (granted) {` replaced by `if (granted && false) {`): anchor 1 -> 0, blob `d18a34fcae07` -> `15cf95da6587`; `src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts` went **6 failed / 187 passed (193)**: the three moved pins and three of the new ones (the fixture pin and the two ⛔ pins stay green by design: they assert a parse, or that no site is recorded). Restore: blob == HEAD (`d18a34fcae07`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **The off-spec shape is dead input.** `ObjectPermissionSchema` is strict and has no `fields` key, so `permissions[].objects.X.fields.Y` is refused at parse. A scan of `examples/`, `packages/apps/` and `packages/qa/` (1026 tracked files, tree `52bcb943a`) for an object grant carrying `fields` found 0 hits, against a control of 14 spec-shaped `'OBJECT.FIELD': { readable ... }` keys. The rule has no branch of its own for the off-spec shape (it reaches it through the generic `fields` write-map read), so no pin of that shape is kept; the generic read is unchanged.
- No public surface moves: no export, no spec key, no error code. The finding's `carriers` array gains entries only where a spec-shaped grant names a declared field.
